layout: 4 columns × 2 rows; idle then casting. Cropped/registered at runtime; native transparent source retained.

prompts.alice: Production game sprite sheet, genuine low resolution pixel art for a 1990s Japanese vertical shoot-em-up / Game Boy Advance. Transparent background. Subject: Alice Margatroid from Touhou: short blonde bob, thin red headband, blue dress with white shoulder cape and red neck ribbon, white frill skirt hem, brown shoes. Both hands visible. No hat. Small floating doll-master witch. Draw full body from slightly above, facing down toward camera/player, airborne, readable compact silhouette, small expressive face, body proportion about 3 heads high. This is an in-game boss sprite, NOT a portrait or illustration. Crisp square pixel clusters, restrained 16-color palette, dark colored 1-pixel outline and 2-3 shade ramps, no anti-alias, no glow, no ground shadow. EXACTLY 8 animation frames in a regular 4 columns by 2 rows grid of equally sized square cells on a wide 2:1 canvas. Every frame same scale and center registration, transparent margins between cells. Logical cell size 48x48 pixels, sprite about 30x38 pixels; show enlarged nearest-neighbor pixels. Top row: four consecutive gentle airborne idle flutter frames, hands low, hair and skirt shifting subtly; bottom row: four consecutive spell casting frames, hands/book raised and sleeves spreading, then arms opening. Keep character design identical across all frames. No extra objects, no borders, no labels, no typography. Render actual transparent alpha.
